scope: Copied and saved installer diagnostics include the computer's hardware, operating system, kernel, session type and installer version.

checks.command: With QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, open the installer progress page under Tahoe and Golden Gate defaults. Click Copy diagnostic and Save log with a simulated failure and live About probes. Compare both outputs, private file permissions, edition, version and diagnostic fields.

coverage_limits: Export was exercised in an offscreen Qt session. This change affects diagnostic export only. Installer lifecycle and desktop rendering were unchanged.
